leadText:
(Japanese: ポケットモンスター・秋のスペシャル！ , Fall Special!) is a 90-minute special, which included a one-hour clip show, that aired immediately after the original broadcast of the episode Pokémon Fashion Flash.

This clipshow was released on a rental VHS series, Pocket Monsters TV Special: Arc Recap, as The Journey to be a Pokémon Master Begins!!.
